findings.claim: The r2 fix (read clientInfo from initialize or per-request _meta) is not enough. In spec 2026-07-28 the _meta clientInfo key is optional, and the spec says servers SHOULD NOT use it to change behaviour. A 2026 client can omit it, so v2 has no agent identity for platform-aware paths, ctx_doctor and ctx_upgrade.
findings.evidence: python-sdk/src/mcp-types/mcp_types/_v2026_07_28/__init__.py:2822-2836 'io.modelcontextprotocol/clientInfo' ... = None; 'Servers SHOULD NOT use it to change their behavior'. python-sdk/docs/whats-new.md:201 'The request-side clientInfo _meta key is optional (the required pair is protocolVersion + clientCapabilities)'. v1 src/server.ts:4921-4926 picks the adapter from getClientVersion().
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY b40d6bdb 2026-03-16 'feat: add MCP clientInfo detection + Antigravity and Kiro adapters'; 7e67952c 2026-05-12 'fix(detect): thread MCP clientInfo through ctx_upgrade to upgrade() (closes #542 partial)'. ORIGINAL_INTENT: 'clientInfo from the MCP handshake is the highest-confidence' signal (src/server.ts:4290-4293). REGRESSION_RISK: a 2026 client with no clientInfo re-breaks #542 (wrong platform in upgrade/doctor). SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: one fixed source, no chain; the generated MCP entry already comes from adapters/table.ts per agent.
findings.fix: Decide one fixed identity source that does not depend on clientInfo: the MCP entry written from adapters/table.ts passes the agent id (argv flag such as --agent <id>). Use clientInfo only for display and the debug report. Add a GP1 case: a 2026 client with no clientInfo still gets the right agent.

findings.claim: The ctx_doctor row 'MCP: this process is the one the host started (clientInfo = agent)' takes its source from `initialize`. ADR-0007 says 2026-07-28 clients send no initialize, so this check has no data for them, and clientInfo may be absent anyway.
findings.evidence: TECH-SPEC.md:224 '| MCP: this process is the one the host started (clientInfo = agent) | `initialize` |'; ADR-0007:12 'remove the initialize/notifications/initialized handshake'; python-sdk _requirements.py:358 '/clientInfo is optional; no initialize handshake occurs'.
findings.fix: Change the source to the agent id fixed in the MCP entry (see the ADR-0007:47 finding). Report the negotiated protocol version and clientInfo (if sent) as info, not as PASS/FAIL.

findings.claim: The ADR says DiscoverResult carries serverInfo. In the 2026-07-28 schema serverInfo moved out of the discover body into each result's _meta.
findings.evidence: python-sdk/docs/whats-new.md:201 'serverInfo moved out of the server/discover result body: servers stamp it into every 2026-era result's _meta instead (spec #3002)'. DiscoverResult in python-sdk _v2026_07_28/__init__.py:2347-2400 has instructions, supportedVersions, ttlMs, cacheScope and no server_info field; serverInfo is a _meta key at lines 736 and 890.
findings.fix: Change the row: DiscoverResult carries supportedVersions, capabilities, instructions, ttlMs, cacheScope; serverInfo goes in result _meta['io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo']. Re-check against schema.ts:678-696 and save the quote in tickets/.

findings.claim: TECH-SPEC names only InitializeResult.instructions as the instructions channel, and the build map sends instructions.md only to InitializeResult. ADR-0007 decision 3 requires the same bytes in DiscoverResult.instructions too.
findings.evidence: TECH-SPEC.md:68 'There are two channels: MCP `InitializeResult.instructions`, and tool descriptions'; TECH-SPEC.md:106 'src/prompt/instructions.md → InitializeResult.instructions'; ADR-0007:42-44 'InitializeResult.instructions for 2025-xx clients / DiscoverResult.instructions for 2026-07-28 clients'.
findings.fix: Update TECH-SPEC §3.1 and the build map: instructions.md → InitializeResult.instructions and DiscoverResult.instructions (same bytes). Make GS5/GP2 lint both outputs.

findings.claim: The debug report has a field 'MCP protocol versions', but ADR-0007 decision 4 says the server keeps no per-connection state. The doc does not say where the report gets the negotiated version and the client name, so an agent cannot send this debug data.
findings.evidence: ADR-0014:30 '... MCP protocol versions |'; ADR-0007:46 'No per-connection state.'
findings.fix: State the source: the server writes the last seen protocolVersion and clientInfo per agent id to context.db at each request (or at initialize). The report reads that row. This also feeds the AI-agent issue intake with maximum debug data.
